usedFor: SatisMeter collects survey responses, and Google Drive copies a file when “New Survey Response Arrives” runs “Copy a File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Survey Response Arrives” in SatisMeter, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each response can start a fresh copy of a follow-up sheet in a chosen folder.

watchOut: SatisMeter triggers are polling, so “Copy a File” runs after a scheduled check.
